latestVersion.changelog:
Edge TTS Cantonese Voice Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generate natural Cantonese TTS audio using Microsoft Edge TTS.
- Supports WhatsApp and Telegram voice replies via trigger phrases.
- Offers multiple tones: normal, slow (sad), fast (happy), and angry, each with custom rate and pitch settings.
- Outputs OGG/Opus audio suitable for messaging platforms.
- Includes example scripts for generating and sending voice notes.
